title: Work Permit
description: We assist with Canadian work permits — whether open, employer-specific, or LMIA-based. Our team ensures every step of your application is handled accurately and efficiently, guiding both workers and employers through a compliant process from start to finish.

requirements.label: Employer-specific work permit
requirements.description: Helps you work for the employer on your LMIA/offer.

other.description: Copy of signed employment contract.
Either a positive LMIA or an offer of employment number (for LMIA-exempt cases—employer submits in Employer Portal).
Valid passport, biometrics, and any medical exam or police certificate if requested (case-by-case via IRCC checklist).

requirements.label: Open Work Permit (where eligible)
requirements.description: Lets you work for any eligible employer.

other.description: Available only in specific situations (e.g., spousal open work permit, PGWP, bridging OWP, etc.).
Employer must not be on the ineligible employers list; some industries are restricted.

title: Study Permit
description: Planning to study in Canada? We help students secure their study permits by preparing strong applications, supporting letters of acceptance, and ensuring full compliance with educational and immigration requirements throughout their academic journey.

other.description: Letter of Acceptance from a DLI (designated learning institution).
PAL/TAL (attestation letter) in most provinces, or CAQ for Québec.
Proof of identity (passport) and biometrics if required.

requirements.label: Financial support
requirements.description: Prove you can pay tuition, living costs, and return travel.

other.description: Receipts showing tuition / housing paid, bank account/GIC, student loan, etc. (acceptable proofs listed by IRCC).

title: Express Entry
description: We manage complete Express Entry profiles under the Federal Skilled Worker, Canadian Experience Class, and Federal Skilled Trades programs. Our support ensures your profile is accurate, competitive, and optimized for invitation success.

requirements.label: CRS & documents for all programs
requirements.description: Create a profile and meet document/test rules.

other.description: Approved language test (IELTS/CELPIP/TEF/TCF) with minimums per stream.
Points are based on age, education, language, work experience, etc. via the CRS.
Minimum of one year continuous full-time skilled work experience (NOC TEER 0, 1, 2, or 3) within the last 10 years.
Meet the minimum language level of CLB 7 and achieve at least 67/100 on the FSW selection grid.

requirements.label: Canadian Experience Class (CEC)
requirements.description: For those with Canadian work experience.

other.description: At least one year of skilled Canadian work experience (NOC TEER 0, 1, 2, or 3) in the last three years.
Meet the minimum language requirement (CLB 7 for NOC 0/1 jobs, CLB 5 for NOC 2/3 jobs).
At least two years of full-time work experience in a skilled trade within the last five years.
Either a valid job offer of full-time employment for at least one year or a certificate of qualification in that trade issued by a Canadian province/territory.

title: Caregiver Program
description: With expertise in caregiver placements, we support clients through the Home Child Care Provider and Home Support Worker pilots. We assist with eligibility checks, LMIA (if needed), work permits, and permanent residence applications under these specialized programs.

requirements.label: Eligibility
requirements.description: Basic requirements to apply under caregiver pilots.

other.description: At least 12 months of full-time work experience in an eligible caregiver occupation (NOC 44100 or 44101).
Language proficiency (CLB 5), valid job offer, and post-secondary education equivalent to one year of Canadian education.

title: Family Sponsorship
description: Reunite with your loved ones through Canada’s family sponsorship programs. Whether sponsoring parents, children, or other eligible relatives, we manage the entire process — ensuring applications are complete, compliant, and meet all immigration requirements.

requirements.label: Sponsor eligibility
requirements.description: You must meet income and status criteria.

other.description: Sponsor must be a Canadian citizen or permanent resident aged 18 or older.
Must demonstrate financial ability to support sponsored relatives.

title: Spousal Sponsorship
description: We assist Canadian citizens and permanent residents in sponsoring their spouses or common-law partners, whether living in Canada or abroad. Our process ensures strong, well-documented applications that minimize delays and maximize approval success.

requirements.label: Relationship proof
requirements.description: Demonstrate a genuine and ongoing relationship.

other.description: Marriage certificate, photos, messages, shared bills or leases, etc.

requirements.label: Sponsor requirements
requirements.description: You must be eligible to sponsor.

other.description: Must be 18+ and a Canadian citizen, PR, or registered Indian under the Canadian Indian Act.

title: Provincial Nominee Program (PNP)
description: We guide applicants through Canada’s Provincial Nominee Programs, helping you choose the right province, meet eligibility criteria, and submit strong applications that increase your chances of nomination and permanent residency success.

requirements.label: Eligibility
requirements.description: Each province sets its own selection criteria.

other.description: Must have skills, education, and work experience that meet a province’s labour market needs.
Receive a nomination certificate from a province or territory before applying for PR.

title: Canadian Citizenship
description: Ready to become a Canadian citizen? We guide you through eligibility assessments, document preparation, and the entire application process. Our goal is to make your transition to full Canadian citizenship smooth, successful, and stress-free.

other.description: Must have been physically present in Canada for at least 1,095 days (3 years) in the past 5 years.
Meet language requirements (CLB 4 or higher) if aged 18–54.

title: Super Visa
description: We help parents and grandparents visit Canada long-term under the Super Visa program. Our services include eligibility assessment, invitation letters, proof of funds review, and insurance verification for a stress-free and approved application.

requirements.label: Documents required
requirements.description: Meet IRCC’s financial and insurance criteria.

other.description: Invitation letter from child or grandchild living in Canada.
Proof of private medical insurance (min. $100,000 coverage, valid for at least 1 year).
Proof of income meeting the minimum necessary income (MNI).

title: Temporary Resident Permit (TRP)
description: Need entry to Canada despite being inadmissible? We prepare TRP applications that explain your circumstances clearly and meet IRCC’s requirements. Our approach ensures your case is presented with care, precision, and strong supporting evidence.

requirements.label: Eligibility
requirements.description: For individuals who are otherwise inadmissible.

other.description: Must show a compelling reason to enter or remain in Canada despite inadmissibility.
May require medicals, police certificates, and supporting letters from Canadian entities.

title: Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA)
description: We assist employers in obtaining LMIAs to hire foreign workers legally and efficiently. Our team ensures all job offers, recruitment efforts, and documentation meet Employment and Social Development Canada (ESDC) standards for smooth approval.

requirements.label: Employer obligations
requirements.description: Steps required before applying for an LMIA.

other.description: Prove that no Canadians or permanent residents are available for the job (recruitment efforts).
Submit LMIA through Service Canada’s online portal with required business and wage documents.

title: GCMS notes and immigration consultation
description: Gain deeper insight into your immigration file through GCMS notes and expert consultation. We help you understand officer remarks, refusals, and application progress while providing personalized guidance to improve your next submission or appeal.

requirements.label: Request process
requirements.description: Get official IRCC case notes through ATIP.

other.description: Can be requested by Canadian citizens, PRs, or anyone with their consent.
Processing time is typically 30 days, providing officer notes and status updates.
